output.summary: Ticket records contradict deprioritisation of Arts. SlotBook tickets (42% of Arts volume, none from other faculties) were all routed to P4 with a 21-day median. They account for about 70% of the resolution gap. Arts non-SlotBook tickets match non-Arts tickets within 0.3 days by category and priority. The remaining gap comes from Tuesday/Thursday-only Lindqvist technician coverage, which Education also experiences. Duplicate rates are similar, so the trivial-ticket claim is unsupported. ACK-P4 tells requesters nothing about priority or timeframe. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unestablished: one uncorroborated meeting, no records, and the former manager declined to be interviewed. The SSO link to the SlotBook rise is confounded by term-start seasonality and the new category. Best next step is a written SlotBook support agreement, a corrected acknowledgement and matched reporting.
